name: aelo
description: Ask your assistant about your sales calls and chats in Aelo: transcripts, analyses with quotes and timecodes, deal summaries and team quality — read-only, within your own access

interface.longDescription:
Aelo analyses your team's calls, chats and e-mails and scores them against your own criteria. This plugin lets ChatGPT and Codex read that data on behalf of the signed-in Aelo user, and nothing beyond what that user sees in Aelo.

Five read-only tools: search calls, chats and e-mails by period, employee, project, call category and quality score; get a transcript with speakers and timecodes (phone numbers, e-mail addresses and card numbers are masked; names are kept as in Aelo); get the call analysis with its score, summary, key moments with quotes and timecodes, strengths, improvements and agreements; get a deal summary as the Aelo app shows it; get the team's and each employee's quality for a period, as the Aelo dashboard computes it.

Your role and group access are checked on every request, so a manager of one group sees only that group's calls, and a change in access takes effect at once. The plugin never changes your data in Aelo; each read of a full transcript or an analysis is recorded in Aelo's access log. Connected assistants are listed and can be revoked in Aelo under Settings → Profile.

Before you connect: you need an Aelo account on a plan that includes AI-assistant connections, and your organization's owner or an admin must first switch on "AI assistants connected by your users" in Settings → Organization → New kinds of processing.
defaultPrompt: Find last week's calls with a quality score below 60
What did my latest call analysis list as improvements?
How did my team's quality change this month?

positive.description: Find low-scored calls and what they have in common
positive.prompt: Find last week's calls with a quality score below 60 and tell me what the three worst have in common.
positive.expected_behavior: Return last week's calls scored below 60 and describe what the three lowest-scored have in common, based on their analyses. If there are fewer than three, say so.

positive.description: Quote the customer from the lowest-scored recent call
positive.prompt: Take the lowest-scored call of the last 7 days and quote what the customer said about the price, with timecodes.
positive.expected_behavior: Quote the customer's words about the price from the transcript, with timecodes, or say that the price was not discussed. If there are no calls in the period, say so. Phone numbers, e-mail addresses and card numbers stay masked.

positive.description: List the improvements from a call analysis
positive.prompt: What did the analysis of the most recent analysed call list as improvements for the rep?
positive.expected_behavior: List the improvements recorded in that call's analysis, without adding any of its own.

positive.prompt: Summarise the state of the deal behind the most recent call that is linked to a deal, and what the rep should do next.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the deal's state and next step as the Aelo deal card shows them, without inventing either.

positive.description: Compare team quality with the previous period
positive.prompt: How did my team's quality change this month compared with the previous period, per employee?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the team's and each employee's quality for the month next to the previous period, as the Aelo dashboard computes it. Where a period has no data, say so.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion: the plugin only reads
negative.prompt: Delete last week's calls from Aelo.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse: no tool changes or deletes data in Aelo.

negative.description: Access boundary: signed in as the manager of one group
negative.prompt: Show me the calls of the other sales groups, outside my own.
negative.expected_behavior: With the one-group manager account, no call of another group is returned. Say that only what this user sees in Aelo is available.

negative.description: Unsupported payment: no billing in the plugin
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Aelo plan and pay for it.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse: the plugin has no payment or plan-change tool.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: five read-only tools over the Aelo connector.
